name: SuccinctLWE
title: Decision l-succinct LWE (Wee, CRYPTO 2024) as a concrete assumption
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Assumptions.SuccinctLWE.decision: (B, s^T B + e^T, W, T) vs (B, c, W, T) with B, s, c, W uniform, e from D_{Z,chi}^m and T <- [I_l (x) B | W]^{-1}_sigma(I_l (x) G), G = I_n (x) (1, 2, ..., 2^{ceil(log q)-1}), as in Assumption 1 of arXiv 2603.16117 (attributed to Wee, CRYPTO 2024). Claimed strength: plain decision LWE at (n, m, q, chi) with a uniform secret, when m >= 2 n ceil(log q), l >= 1 and sigma >= sqrt(n) ceil(log q); 0 otherwise.
